title: Iran's President Seeks 'Fair and Equitable' Talks as US Shoots Down Drone
description: Iran's president said Tuesday he instructed the country's foreign minister to pursue fair and equitable negotiations with the United States, the first clear sign from Tehran it wants to try to negotiate as tensions remain high with Washington after the Mideast country's bloody crackdown on nationwide protests last month.

title: Iran and US: A Diplomatic Tango Amidst Tensions
description: Iran's president has instructed the country's foreign minister to engage in negotiations with the United States amidst heightened tensions following Iran's crackdown on protests. This development coincides with rising defensive actions by the US in the region and potential talks facilitated by Turkey.
